title: Quintessential Egyptian Lentils Stew
description: A rich, umami-packed vegan lentil stew simmered to perfection in a stone-bowl-dolsot tajine clay pot, ideal for a lazy Sunday meal.
instructions: Rinse lentils under cold water until water runs clear.
Heat olive oil in a tajine clay pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, and chili powder; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Mix in tomato paste, diced tomatoes, and rinsed lentils; stir until lentils coat with spices.
Pour in water, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low.
Cover pot and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper, taste, and adjust if needed.
Remove from heat and let sit covered for 5 minutes to thicken.
Serve hot, directly from the stone-bowl-dolsot.
